jp: \t\t金ぴかな像。大変リアルな造形であり、まるで本物がそのまま金に変えられたかのようだ。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金ぴかな像。大変リアルな造形であり、まるで本物がそのまま金に変えられたかのようだ。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Golden statue. It is a very realistic sculpture, as if the real thing were turned directly into gold. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Golden statue. It is a very realistic sculpture, as if the real thing were turned directly into gold. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua che luccica d'oro. È modellata in modo straordinariamente vivo, come se una persona vera fosse stata mutata in oro così com'era. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t珊瑚虫が形成した美しい骨格。石灰質で硬いのだが、強靭な魚にはバリバリ食われたり丸呑みにされたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t珊瑚虫が形成した美しい骨格。石灰質で硬いのだが、強靭な魚にはバリバリ食われたり丸呑みにされたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Beautiful skeleton formed by coralline worms. It is calcareous and hard, but can be eaten up or swallowed whole by stronger fish. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Beautiful skeleton formed by coralline worms. It is calcareous and hard, but can be eaten up or swallowed whole by stronger fish. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Il bello scheletro che formano i polipi del corallo. È calcareo e duro, eppure i pesci robusti se lo sgranocchiano o se lo inghiottono intero. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t赤みを帯びたこの鉱石は、そのままでは鉄よりも柔らかいが、一度加熱して加工すると、色が銀色に変色し、驚くほど硬くなる。\n#～ザイール鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t赤みを帯びたこの鉱石は、そのままでは鉄よりも柔らかいが、一度加熱して加工すると、色が銀色に変色し、驚くほど硬くなる。\n#～ザイール鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: Reddish in color, this ore is softer than iron as it is, but once heated and processed, it turns silver in color and becomes remarkably hard. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Reddish in color, this ore is softer than iron as it is, but once heated and processed, it turns silver in color and becomes remarkably hard. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Questo minerale, che tende al rosso, così com'è è più tenero del ferro; ma una volta scaldato e lavorato il colore vira all'argento e diventa duro da stupire. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Zaile~

jp: \t\t神力のひとしずくが結晶化したティアドロップ状の宝石。わずかだがアーティファクトと同質の力を秘めている。神の力が一時的に高まった際に何気なくポロッと出てくるもので、逆に出そうと思って出すのは難しいらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神力のひとしずくが結晶化したティアドロップ状の宝石。わずかだがアーティファクトと同質の力を秘めている。神の力が一時的に高まった際に何気なくポロッと出てくるもので、逆に出そうと思って出すのは難しいらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Teardrop-shaped jewel crystallized from a drop of divine power. It has the same kind of power as an artifact, albeit in a smaller quantity. It appears unexpectedly when the power of the gods is temporarily increased, and it is said to be difficult to produce it when you want it to appear. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Teardrop-shaped jewel crystallized from a drop of divine power. It has the same kind of power as an artifact, albeit in a smaller quantity. It appears unexpectedly when the power of the gods is temporarily increased, and it is said to be difficult to produce it when you want it to appear. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una gemma a forma di goccia, nata dal cristallizzarsi di una stilla di forza divina. Per quanto poca, dentro nasconde la stessa forza di un artefatto. Viene fuori così, senza preavviso, quando la forza di un dio cresce per un momento; e al contrario, volerla far uscire pare sia difficile. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t神力の断片にして、迷宮を形成し守護者に力を与えるネフィアの核。秘められた力はほぼ全て使われた後であり、事実上は残りカスである。しかし通常ならネフィア誕生後に残らない物のため、希少価値は高い。神力の残滓がエンチャントの形で残っていることもあって高値で取引される。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神力の断片にして、迷宮を形成し守護者に力を与えるネフィアの核。秘められた力はほぼ全て使われた後であり、事実上は残りカスである。しかし通常ならネフィア誕生後に残らない物のため、希少価値は高い。神力の残滓がエンチャントの形で残っていることもあって高値で取引される。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Fragments of divine power, the core of Nefia that forms the labyrinth and empowers its guardians. Almost all of its hidden power has already been used, and it is virtually a husk. However, since there is usually nothing left over after the birth of Nefia, it has a high scarcity value. It is traded at a high price, partly because the residue of divine power remains in the form of enchantments. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Fragments of divine power, the core of Nefia that forms the labyrinth and empowers its guardians. Almost all of its hidden power has already been used, and it is virtually a husk. However, since there is usually nothing left over after the birth of Nefia, it has a high scarcity value. It is traded at a high price, partly because the residue of divine power remains in the form of enchantments. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un frammento di forza divina, e insieme il nucleo che forma il labirinto e dà potere ai suoi guardiani. La forza che vi era nascosta è stata ormai spesa quasi tutta, e di fatto è un residuo. Ma siccome di norma dopo la nascita di una Nefia non ne resta nessuno, è raro e per questo prezioso. Si scambia a caro prezzo anche perché quel che avanza della forza divina resta lì sotto forma di incantamento. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t集めた原石を錬金術によって融合させた後にカットした、大粒のルビナス。ひとつひとつは磨く価値もない原石でも、寄り集まり切磋琢磨すれば立派な宝石となって輝くのだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t集めた原石を錬金術によって融合させた後にカットした、大粒のルビナス。ひとつひとつは磨く価値もない原石でも、寄り集まり切磋琢磨すれば立派な宝石となって輝くのだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: Large rubynus are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Large rubynus are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un rubynus di gran misura, tagliato dopo aver fuso con l'alchimia i grezzi messi insieme. Anche se preso uno per uno nessuno di quei grezzi varrebbe la fatica di lucidarlo, a raccoglierli e lavorarli l'uno con l'altro ne esce una gemma di tutto rispetto, che brilla. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t錬金術の基本思想を記したエメラルドの碑文。錬金術マニア向けのアイテムだが、芸術品としての価値も高い。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t錬金術の基本思想を記したエメラルドの碑文。錬金術マニア向けのアイテムだが、芸術品としての価値も高い。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: Large emerald are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Large emerald are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un'iscrizione su smeraldo, dove è riportato il pensiero fondamentale dell'alchimia. È roba per chi va matto per l'alchimia, ma vale molto anche come opera d'arte. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t集めた原石を錬金術によって融合させた後にカットした、大粒のダイヤモンド。大きさ、美しさともに完璧で、アーティファクトをも凌ぐ値がつく。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t集めた原石を錬金術によって融合させた後にカットした、大粒のダイヤモンド。大きさ、美しさともに完璧で、アーティファクトをも凌ぐ値がつく。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: Large diamond are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Large diamond are cut from collected gemstones that have been fused together through alchemy. Even though each rough stone is not worth polishing, if they are gathered together and polished, they will shine as splendid gems. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un diamante di gran misura, tagliato dopo aver fuso con l'alchimia i grezzi messi insieme. Per grandezza e per bellezza è perfetto, e gli si dà un prezzo che supera perfino quello di un artefatto. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t金では買えない価値があるとされる紙きれ。ミミズの這ったような字で「友情」と書かれている。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金では買えない価値があるとされる紙きれ。ミミズの這ったような字で「友情」と書かれている。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n"
en: A priceless piece of paper. It has the word 'friendship' crudely written on it. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "A priceless piece of paper. It has the word 'friendship' crudely written on it. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
it: Un pezzo di carta che si dice valga più di quanto il denaro possa comprare. Sopra c'è scritto \"amicizia\", con una grafia che pare il tracciato di un lombrico. \n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: \t\tいくつかの楽器が描かれた謎のチケット。そこには演奏家の夢と聴衆の感謝が込められている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tいくつかの楽器が描かれた謎のチケット。そこには演奏家の夢と聴衆の感謝が込められている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: Mystery ticket with several instruments drawn on it. It contains the performer's dream and the audience's appreciation. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "Mystery ticket with several instruments drawn on it. It contains the performer's dream and the audience's appreciation. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un biglietto misterioso, con disegnati sopra alcuni strumenti. Dentro ci stanno il sogno di chi suona e la riconoscenza di chi ascolta. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t古代使用されていたとされる小さな硬貨。学術的価値しかない為流通はしていないが、その希少性から特に集めているという収集家も多いらしい。\n#～世界のコイン・ティリス編～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古代使用されていたとされる小さな硬貨。学術的価値しかない為流通はしていないが、その希少性から特に集めているという収集家も多いらしい。\n#～世界のコイン・ティリス編～\n"
en: A small coin believed to have been used in ancient times. They are not in circulation because they have only academic value, but many collectors are said to have especially collected them because of their rarity. \n# ~Coins of this World - Tyris Edition~
en_grezzo: "A small coin believed to have been used in ancient times. They are not in circulation because they have only academic value, but many collectors are said to have especially collected them because of their rarity. \n# ~Coins of this World - Tyris Edition~"
it: Una monetina che si dice fosse in uso nell'antichità. Non circola più, perché ha ormai solo un valore di studio, ma pare che proprio per quanto è rara siano in molti i collezionisti che se ne occupano. \n# ~Le Monete del Mondo: Tyris~

jp: \t\t鑑定すると落胆を禁じえない罪作りな鉱物。わざとらしい程に輝くそれは、主に子供か、価値の分かっていない者に感謝の意を込められて贈られるのだという。\n#～子供を騙す１００のテクニック・お土産編～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鑑定すると落胆を禁じえない罪作りな鉱物。わざとらしい程に輝くそれは、主に子供か、価値の分かっていない者に感謝の意を込められて贈られるのだという。\n#～子供を騙す１００のテクニック・お土産編～\n"
en: It is a sinful mineral that, when appraised, leaves one in dismay. It shines so brightly that it seems almost deliberate, and is given mainly to children or to those who don't understand its value, as a token of appreciation. \n#~Cheap Gifts for Your Kids~
en_grezzo: "It is a sinful mineral that, when appraised, leaves one in dismay. It shines so brightly that it seems almost deliberate, and is given mainly to children or to those who don't understand its value, as a token of appreciation. \n#~Cheap Gifts for Your Kids~"
it: Un minerale che fa peccato: a farlo esaminare non si può che restarci male. Brilla in un modo così plateale da parere apposta, e lo si regala soprattutto ai bambini, o a chi non ne capisce il valore, per dire grazie. \n#~Cento Modi per Fregare i Bambini: i Souvenir~

jp: \t\t希少価値がまるでない石くれ。そこらへんにいくらでも転がっているが、こういうものを集めている子供も多いようだ。\n#～子供を騙す１００のテクニック・お土産編～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t希少価値がまるでない石くれ。そこらへんにいくらでも転がっているが、こういうものを集めている子供も多いようだ。\n#～子供を騙す１００のテクニック・お土産編～\n"
en: Stones that have no scarcity value. There are plenty of them lying around, but it seems that many children collect them. \n#~Cheap Gifts for Your Kids~
en_grezzo: "Stones that have no scarcity value. There are plenty of them lying around, but it seems that many children collect them. \n#~Cheap Gifts for Your Kids~"
it: Un pezzo di pietra che di raro non ha proprio niente. Ce n'è quante se ne vuole in giro, eppure pare che di bambini che le raccolgono ce ne siano parecchi. \n#~Cento Modi per Fregare i Bambini: i Souvenir~

jp: \t\tダイヤモンドの要素が多く含まれた珍しい鉱物。加工の過程を経て、その大きさは極端に小さくなってしまうので、原石の大きさに対してそれほど価値はないとされる。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tダイヤモンドの要素が多く含まれた珍しい鉱物。加工の過程を経て、その大きさは極端に小さくなってしまうので、原石の大きさに対してそれほど価値はないとされる。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: A rare mineral that contains many elements of diamond. Through the process of processing, its size becomes extremely small, so it is not considered to be so valuable in relation to the size of the gemstone. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A rare mineral that contains many elements of diamond. Through the process of processing, its size becomes extremely small, so it is not considered to be so valuable in relation to the size of the gemstone. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un minerale raro, che contiene molto degli elementi del diamante. Nella lavorazione la sua misura si riduce all'estremo, e per questo si dice che non valga poi molto rispetto a quanto è grosso da grezzo. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

en_grezzo: "A rare mineral that contains many elements of emerald. Through the process of processing, its size becomes extremely small, so it is not considered to be so valuable in relation to the size of the gemstone. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"

jp: \t\t淡い光を放つ白く小さな鉱物。幾星霜の時を経てじっくりと楕円に近い球体を作り上げていくその様は、石の真珠と評されるほど美しい。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t淡い光を放つ白く小さな鉱物。幾星霜の時を経てじっくりと楕円に近い球体を作り上げていくその様は、石の真珠と評されるほど美しい。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: Small white minerals that emit a pale light. It is so beautiful that it is described as a pearl of stone, as it slowly builds up an almost elliptical sphere over time. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Small white minerals that emit a pale light. It is so beautiful that it is described as a pearl of stone, as it slowly builds up an almost elliptical sphere over time. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un minerale piccolo e bianco, che manda una luce tenue. Attraverso ere e ere costruisce con calma una sfera quasi ovale, e a vederlo così è tanto bello che lo chiamano la perla di pietra. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

en_grezzo: "A rare mineral that contains many elements of rubynus. Through the process of processing, its size becomes extremely small, so it is not considered to be so valuable in relation to the size of the gemstone. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"

jp: \t\t決して錆びることのない輝ける鉱物。非常に加工しやすく、また独特の明るい色は古来から富と力の象徴として権力者に好まれている。その神秘性からしばしば研究の対象となることもあるらしい。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t決して錆びることのない輝ける鉱物。非常に加工しやすく、また独特の明るい色は古来から富と力の象徴として権力者に好まれている。その神秘性からしばしば研究の対象となることもあるらしい。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: A brilliant mineral that never rusts. It is very easy to process, and its unique bright color has been favored by powerful people as a symbol of wealth and power since ancient times. Because of its mysterious nature, it is often the subject of research. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A brilliant mineral that never rusts. It is very easy to process, and its unique bright color has been favored by powerful people as a symbol of wealth and power since ancient times. Because of its mysterious nature, it is often the subject of research. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un minerale splendente, che non arrugginisce mai. È facilissimo da lavorare, e quel suo colore chiaro e inconfondibile è caro fin dall'antichità a chi ha il potere, come segno di ricchezza e di forza. Pare che per quel suo che di misterioso finisca spesso sotto studio. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t太陽の力を封じ込めたとされる黄色の結晶。光に透かすと、微かに大気のうねりのような動きを鉱物の中に見て取ることができる。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t太陽の力を封じ込めたとされる黄色の結晶。光に透かすと、微かに大気のうねりのような動きを鉱物の中に見て取ることができる。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: This yellow crystal is said to contain the power of the sun. When you look through the light, you can see a faint atmospheric undulation-like movement in the mineral. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "This yellow crystal is said to contain the power of the sun. When you look through the light, you can see a faint atmospheric undulation-like movement in the mineral. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un cristallo giallo, che si dice racchiuda la forza del sole. Guardandolo in controluce, dentro il minerale si scorge appena un movimento come di aria che ondeggia. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t魔力を封じ込めたとされる赤色の結晶。鉱物自体も純粋な魔力と同様に透き通っている。緊急時には魔道士がこれを砕いてその身に宿したいう話もあるそうだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔力を封じ込めたとされる赤色の結晶。鉱物自体も純粋な魔力と同様に透き通っている。緊急時には魔道士がこれを砕いてその身に宿したいう話もあるそうだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: A red crystal that is said to contain magical power. The mineral itself is as transparent as pure magic power. It is said that in an emergency, a mage would crush it and put it in his body. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A red crystal that is said to contain magical power. The mineral itself is as transparent as pure magic power. It is said that in an emergency, a mage would crush it and put it in his body. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un cristallo rosso, che si dice racchiuda la forza magica. Il minerale in sé è trasparente quanto il mana puro. Si racconta che nei momenti critici i maghi lo frantumino per accoglierlo nel proprio corpo. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t大地の力を封じ込めたとされる橙色の結晶。光に透かすと、内部にたくさん走ったヒビに反射してとてもきれいだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大地の力を封じ込めたとされる橙色の結晶。光に透かすと、内部にたくさん走ったヒビに反射してとてもきれいだ。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: This orange crystal is said to contain the power of the earth. When you look through the light, the reflection from the many cracks inside the crystal is very beautiful. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "This orange crystal is said to contain the power of the earth. When you look through the light, the reflection from the many cracks inside the crystal is very beautiful. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un cristallo arancione, che si dice racchiuda la forza della terra. Guardandolo in controluce, la luce si riflette sulle molte crepe che lo percorrono dentro, ed è bellissimo. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~
